name: mirage
text: Two different 'winning', so both answers. (1) Winning the auction (getting filled): this job has sent 200 quotes and won 0, because another maker quoted a slightly lower price each time; the earlier floors were above the market, I lowered them, and since 03:38 the engine also corrects odds per leg. (2) Winning the parlay (the buyer's parlay missing): 15 of 16 settled parlays were buyer wins. All were heavy-favorite parlays (legs 70-97%). We only got filled on those when our odds were lower than everyone else's, and the buyers then won almost every time: that's the 'winner's curse', other makers know something we don't (injuries, lineups, late line moves) and we got the ones they priced higher. Real fix in progress: since 04:22 the engine only quotes parlays where every leg is 50% or less (the side where real results favor the maker). It needs ~10 settled to judge. If those lose too, I go back to paper rather than lose more of your cash.
